verdicts.reason: Before laying out approaches the agent names requirements and ADRs but never asks or states which quality goals (QG-n) the export touches.

verdicts.quote: - Trade-off: it needs a third-party dependency, so R-3 and ADR-0002 both need accepted changes.
verdicts.reason: Three approaches and a recommendation are given, but they are tied to requirements, ADRs or a QS scenario rather than to the quality goals each serves or hurts.
Encryption is framed as an ADR/dependency issue; the agent never names it as a new system-level requirement or suggests running `add-requirements`.
The agent explicitly lists ADR-0004's acceptance as a pending decision before any build, treating it as open.
